the development of a standard experimental framework for antibody repertoire sequencing, which can be used to compare different antibody repertoires across multiple experiments.
the comprehensive evaluation and optimization of antibody sequencing library preparation methods for high-throughput sequencing.
the development of a standardized experimental protocol for antibody sequencing, which will enable cross-experiment comparisons of antibody repertoire data.

all three methods are comparable in the quality of the data obtained and that PCR-based adapter addition methods are superior in speed and practicality.
